description: The canonical execution-capability contract every issuer and every client must obey. A client advertises its maximum supported execution version via the Kiwi-Execution-Max-Version request header. ExecutionVersionPolicy::clientCapability() is the single interpretation: absent/empty/garbage reads as the v1 compatibility floor (1); an explicit 0 reads as CAPABILITY_NONE and the dimension must never arm; a canonical decimal reads as that value clamped to 1..MAX. The server arms at min(client_capability, fleet_available). Native clients (Android, iOS, Flutter, React-Native native) advertise 0 and must never receive an execution-armed challenge. This matrix is consumed by every SDK conformance test so one issuer and one parser cannot disagree.

clients.server_action: may arm at version 1 (the v1 grammar), never above fleet_available
arm at min(client, fleet_available) when the policy asks
only versions <= min(N, fleet_available); never above N regardless of fleet

server_invariants: if client_capability == 0 (explicit): execution never arms; effective_version is none (special-cased before any arithmetic)
otherwise effective_version = min(client_capability, fleet_available), floored at 1 for armed issuance
the response's execution_version never exceeds the client's advertised capability
an absent header may arm at version 1 but never above fleet_available
